speech.speak.description: Says text out loud with your text-to-speech voice. It joins the speech queue. Nothing is said when speech is turned off or the text is empty.

parameters.text: What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!"
parameters.alias: Optional. The voice name (alias) to use, as set on the Speech page. Leave it out for your default voice.
parameters.wait: Optional. true waits until the text has been spoken before your script goes on. Default false.
parameters.silent: Optional. true only makes the sound file and does not play it. Default false.
parameters.badWordFilter: Optional. true runs the text through your speech word filters first. Default false.

speech.speak.returns: Nothing, unless wait or silent is true. Then it gives back success (false when skipped or speech is off), duration in milliseconds, and speechFile (the saved sound file, or empty).

speech.stop.description: Stops the text that is being spoken right now. The queue goes on with the next one.

speech.clear.description: Throws away every text that is waiting in the speech queue. The text being spoken right now keeps playing.

speech.pause.description: Pauses the speech queue, or starts it again. Texts keep waiting while it is paused.

parameters.paused: Optional. true pauses, false starts it again. Default true.

speech.setEnabled.description: Turns all text-to-speech on or off. While it is off, new texts are not spoken.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns speech on, false turns it off. Default true.

speech.setEvents.description: Turns spoken event alerts (like follows and raids) on or off.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns event speech on, false turns it off. Default true.

speech.setUserVoice.description: Gives a viewer their own voice. Their chat messages are then read with it. An empty alias resets them to the normal voice.

parameters.platform: The platform of the viewer, like "twitch".
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer". Give this, the user id, or both.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's user id. You can give this, the name, or both.
parameters.alias: The voice name (alias) from the Speech page, like "Robot". Empty resets the voice.

speech.stopUser.description: Throws away a viewer's waiting texts and stops theirs if it is playing right now.

parameters.platform: The platform of the viewer, like "twitch".
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer's name, like "SpammyViewer". Give this, the user id, or both.
parameters.userId: Optional. The viewer's user id. You can give this, the name, or both.

speech.stopUser.returns: How many texts were stopped or thrown away (0 when no name or id was given).

speech.activateVoiceGate.description: Switches to a VoiceGate profile. VoiceGate holds speech back while you are talking. Use "none" (or empty) to switch VoiceGate off.

parameters.profile: The profile name as set on the Speech page, like "Talking". "none" switches it off.

speech.activateVoiceGate.returns: true when it worked, false when no profile has that name.

speech.state.description: Tells you what text-to-speech is doing right now.
speech.state.returns: enabled, paused, eventsEnabled (true/false), queueLength (how many texts wait), current (the text being spoken, or empty) and voiceGate (true while VoiceGate holds speech back).
